These are all of the branding assets used outside of KDS (NALStudio Game Launcher, etc.)


NOTES:

bannerV2 was created since something has changed in Roboto text rendering (glyph changed or paint.net renders it differently)
thus making the K and R be inconsistent between the KDS and Level Builder banners.
The V2 version still uses Roboto, but it is rendered like in the level builder banner.
